top_signals.title: NYC Horse Carriages Set to Be Banned in 2028 After Deal
top_signals.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani and the New York City Council speaker reached a deal on legislation to ban horse-drawn carriages, potentially putting an end to a Central Park staple and tourist magnet that began operating more than 150 years ago.

top_signals.title: Ancora in Push for UK’s Big Yellow Group to Explore Sale
top_signals.summary: Activist investor Ancora Holdings Group has built a stake in UK-listed Big Yellow Group Plc and is pushing the self-storage company to explore a sale, according to a statement from the fund.
